context: Saito gives Ryosuke a careful diagnosis.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 亮介さん、診断、本当、慎重に。
lines.en: Ryosuke—I want to be very careful with your diagnosis.
lines.style: Open with his name, steady and clear. Slight pause before the commitment. Warm but measured, the professional composure audible beneath real care. Deliberate pace on 'very careful'—this matters.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.style: Quick, genuine nod in the voice. Slight breathiness on the opening. Respectful but not stiff. The soft gratitude of someone entrusting something precious, delivered with quiet dignity.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 健康、本当、保ちましょう。
lines.style: Gentle invitation rather than instruction. Warm tone, almost conspiratorial—you and him together in this. A small smile in the voice. Not lecturing, partnering.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 一緒に、本当、頑張ります。
lines.en: I'll do my best—we both will.
lines.style: Soft commitment on the opening. Slight lift on 'we both'—he's including her in this promise. Tender, resolute without strain. The voice of someone who means what he says and knows she does too.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: Come talk to me anytime. I mean it.
lines.style: Direct eye-contact level. Slight emphasis on 'anytime'—the real offer, not a courtesy. Warm but serious. A small pause at the end, letting it land. This is a real door, left open.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.style: Quiet depth. The word 'grateful' lands fully. Slow pace. 'Always' trails slightly—not trailing off, but settling, like a promise to himself as much as to her. Genuine, not performed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.style: Warm close. Returns his sincerity without echoing it. Composed, professional boundaries held gently. A small smile—the acknowledgment of real connection, delivered as a doctor who has just seen a father care deeply. Final word softens slightly.
